name: deepdeck
description: DeepDeck desktop client built on DeepSeek Harness
author: jo32

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm harness:install && pnpm codex-connect:install && pnpm harness:build && pnpm build
scripts.codex-connect:check: pnpm codex-connect:deps && node scripts/verify-codex-connect-patch.mjs && pnpm --dir vendor/dsh-codex-connect run typecheck
scripts.codex-connect:test: pnpm codex-connect:check && pnpm --dir vendor/dsh-codex-connect run test
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm codex-connect:build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-market-desktop-bridge run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-bun-plugin-builder run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-first-run run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-conversations run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-computer-use run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-provider-aware-web run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run build && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run build && node scripts/start-build-cache.mjs record
scripts.check: pnpm codex-connect:check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-market-desktop-bridge run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-bun-plugin-builder run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-first-run run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-conversations run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-computer-use run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-provider-aware-web run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run check && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run check && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run check && pnpm web:check
scripts.test: pnpm test:start-cache && pnpm codex-connect:test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-market-desktop-bridge run test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-bun-plugin-builder run test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-first-run run test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-app-conversations run test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-computer-use run test && pnpm --filter @deepdeck/dsh-provider-aware-web run test && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run test
scripts.package:local: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:prepare && node scripts/build-desktop-package.mjs --local && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --local
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:prepare && node scripts/build-desktop-package.mjs --mac && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs --production
